# Store data assignments can declare continuation intent

## Context

Related: neomjs/neo-agent-institution#602. Loading older Mailbox rows must retain the reader's position. The Mailbox deliberately recomputes its complete in-memory projection so thread counts, collapse facts and fresh pooled-cell records stay coherent. It has no fetch pipeline. The existing fetched-page append path from #19368 cannot express that operation publicly.

Design authority: `grid.Body.onStoreLoad` already treats `postChunkLoad` as continuation and suppresses its normal top-reset dispatch. The operator's reading-position requirement and the Store-owned boundary are recorded on [Institution #602](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/602), including Vega's independent [contract read](https://github.com/neomjs/neo-agent-institution/issues/602#issuecomment-6075931689).

## The Problem

A current AgentMailbox/Store probe projects 50 then 100 rows through `Grid.applyBags`. Both loads report `postChunkLoad:false`; row identities are fresh, counts correct and thread facts coherent. The grid consequently treats the continuation as a new dataset and requests a scroll to the top. An application must not call the Store's private `addLoadedItems`, fabricate a fetch pipeline, or restore scroll after a visible jump.

## The Architectural Reality

At Engine `1c43d51e`, `src/data/Store.mjs` owns data assignment (`beforeSetData` / `afterSetData`), record creation, filtering, and load publication. `addLoadedItems` already scopes a private continuation flag synchronously with `try/finally`; `onCollectionMutate` emits the existing `postChunkLoad` field. `src/grid/Body.mjs:1314` consumes that field. The installed Engine `699bcb9b` has identical Store/Grid source on these paths.

Prescription checked: `Neo.data.Store` owns the intent on data assignment. `Grid` must consume the existing notification contract; a new view-local scroll policy would treat the symptom. This is a bounded additive Body API, with no new subsystem, wire format, config primitive, or breaking default. Structure map: N/A — existing `src/data/Store.mjs` and existing data/grid tests; no new module placement.

## The Fix

Add public synchronous `store.setData(data, {continuation = false} = {})`. It assigns through the existing reactive `data` config and scopes the existing continuation-notification context for that synchronous operation, restoring its prior value even if a config hook or listener throws. It returns no value. It does not append data, bypass hooks, alter ordinary data-assignment semantics, or fetch anything.

The downstream Mailbox will choose continuation only for an older-page extension, and continue to use ordinary replacement on a first page or subject switch. That consumer and its actual browser paging witness remain Institution #602.

### Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Behavior | Default/fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Store.setData(data, options)` (new) | existing reactive `data` config | synchronous assignment with explicit `continuation` intent; same records, filtering, sorting and config hooks as direct assignment | omitted/false uses ordinary load notification; returns void | method JSDoc | AC-1, AC-2 |
| existing `load.postChunkLoad` | `Store.onCollectionMutate` → `grid.Body.onStoreLoad` | true during a declared continuation commit; no empty intermediate load introduced | ordinary later assignments/adds/sorts keep their current notification | existing event/method docs | AC-1, AC-3 |
| continuation context retirement | existing `addLoadedItems` scoped pattern | nested setData calls and thrown hooks restore the previous context | later unrelated mutations do not inherit continuation | method JSDoc | AC-2 |

Decision Record impact: none. Architectural routing: ticket-intake + focused unit/browser verification; no ideation graduation needed for this additive use of an existing event contract.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: Data-config-driven stores retain assignment semantics in eager and lazy modes, with filtering/sorting and fresh record identities where the existing setter creates them. Continuation loads are marked; omitted/false remains ordinary. Test growing, shorter and empty projections without duplicate rows or incorrect counts.
- [ ] AC-2: Config hooks remain observable; a nested explicit ordinary assignment and a thrown hook/listener cannot leak continuation into subsequent operations. No fetch or direct private-helper call is required.
- [ ] AC-3: A mounted-grid regression observes no top-reset dispatch for continuation assignment and does observe the existing reset on ordinary assignment. Existing fetched append controls continue to pass.
- [ ] AC-4: The API and its limits are documented. The downstream browser/installed witness remains linked on Institution #602; this Engine PR does not claim that consumer is delivered.

## Out of Scope

Mailbox ownership/freshness, thread policy, selection APIs, changing ordinary grid reset behavior, a new paging mechanism, or fixing unrelated data-setter semantics.

## Avoided Traps

No Grid-specific option on Store, persistent append flag, silent batching that corrupts collection counts, fake remote pipeline, or post-render scroll restoration. Reuse the current notification; do not create a parallel event family.
